policy.h1_blocker: Unknown geometry or mating truth changes the dimensioned mockup, routing corridor, enclosure aperture or user-reviewed placement and must close before H1.1.4 is frozen.
policy.h5_received_sample_gate: Before order, H5 closes only source-backed identity, drawings, geometry/DRC, structural load paths and deterministic assembly/inspection instructions. Fit, continuity and ordinary operation of the one assembled prototype are post-arrival H7/H8 evidence; they cannot be prerequisites for fabricating that same prototype and do not require artificial ageing or extra assembled devices.

execution_constraint.sequence: Exhaust controlled public sources, compare function-preserving documented replacements, request missing manufacturer data without an order, and consider a smallest evidence sample only as a separately approved last resort.

gates.evidence_boundary: EastRising controls the exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 plus ER-TPC035-6 assembly, 56.54x84.96-mm CTP outline and folded 50-contact 0.50-mm tail, including the 30.16 +/-0.50-mm edge-to-tip length, 25.50 +/-0.15-mm contact-tongue width, 0.30-mm stiffener and drawing-view 50-left/1-right order. L2-DISP-DIRECT-001-A fixes the top-and-bottom-contact FH34SRJ at [24.00,25.00] on the UI PCB inner face, a rounded 27.00x1.20-mm tongue slot at [24.00,23.00], one no-twist 180-degree fold, 1-to-1 / 50-to-50 orientation, at least 5.00 mm of relaxed service slack, an adhesive-free folded-FPC upper zone, one stock-format 50.00x50.00-mm PSA rectangle at [12.50,44.46], and separate PSA and DISPLAY/FPC-UP silkscreen datums. The rectangle supports 2500 mm2 or about 52.0% of the panel plan; no separate upper strip or custom converter contour is required and the ZIF is not load-bearing.
gates.unknown: Current-lot folded FPC maximum component stack, exact 180-degree bend radius, actual insertion, one exact traceable stocked 50x50-mm industrial acrylic-foam MPN and the assembler's accepted material/process remain properties of the one-prototype route. The 1.00-mm drawing envelope and reseller 3M VHB 4910 pads prove only that the format exists; neither is a released production selection. The earlier 0.17-mm 3M 9495LE candidate is too thin unless measurement unexpectedly proves the required 0.20-mm clearance.
gates.closure: Before order, H5 locks the source-backed direct-ZIF footprint and rotation, mandatory board -Y / antenna-edge tail direction, rounded tongue slot and keep-outs, one-fold/no-twist 1-to-1 / 50-to-50 insertion, received dry-fit neutral-axis route <=24.66 mm with >=5.00-mm relaxed slack, current-lot folded-stack height plus at least 0.20-mm clearance, exact bend radius, exact traceable stocked 50x50-mm adhesive MPN and source, both silkscreen datums, cleaning/pressure/dwell instruction and written assembler acceptance. A custom contour is allowed only if the same PCBA factory confirms manufacture and installation inside the order; no external converter order. H7/H8 inspect insertion, strain relief, retention and continuity after arrival.

gates.evidence_boundary: Ebyte's 2025 E01-ML01SP4 specification proves the 14.5 x 18 x 2.4-mm outline, all ten lands and the fitted IPEX location; the current official page proves stable production and PA/LNA performance. Exact TE 2118651-2 30-mm UMCC Gen1 jumpers and Hirose U.FL-R-SMT-1(80) board mates define all three paper feed assemblies.
gates.unknown: The fitted receptacle manufacturer's exact subpart MPN, actual mate retention, bend/strain behaviour and end-to-end RF loss remain received-part properties. H1 uses the published connector location and full maximum body envelope; H5/H8 verify the real fit and RF path.
gates.closure: H5 locks the conservative corridor and exact documented cable/board-mate identities before order; H7/H8 confirm the fitted receptacle is Gen1 and inspect fit, retention, flex/strain relief, insertion loss and return loss on the one assembled prototype after arrival.

gates.evidence_boundary: M5Stack proves the 84x24x15.287-mm Cap envelope, 2x7 2.54-mm topology and 56-mm retention pitch. Samtec proves the exact HLE-107-02-G-DV-PE-LC pass-through body, standard 0.635-mm square-post class, 1.78-mm minimum insertion and absence of a closed bottoming limit. H1 fixes the Cap body to the retention datums and lets the undocumented post length pass through the raised rail.
gates.unknown: Current U214 post section, insertion force, contact retention, retention-screw engagement and final compliant rail preload remain received-part properties; absent manufacturer limits remain design-analysis inputs and do not create an artificial cycle test.
gates.closure: H5 locks the source-backed envelope, pass-through host geometry and deterministic assembly instruction before order; H7/H8 verify the received U214 post and perform ordinary assembly/disassembly, fit, bottoming-clearance, contact-continuity and retention inspection after arrival without a prescribed force or cycle programme.

gates.evidence_boundary: Five exact, active and orderable OMRON B3S-1100P switches form UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT and OK. Every direction is a separate direct-press serial component; no custom cap, plunger, cross or guide exists. The manufacturer drawing fixes each 6.6x6.0x4.3-mm body, 3.3-mm plunger, force, travel and IEC IP67-equivalent switch boundary.
gates.unknown: Assembled enclosure opening access, accidental-press margin, multi-button feel and sealing boundary.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact switch bodies, openings and DRC before order; H7/H8 inspect the one assembled front panel after arrival for access, ordinary actuation, accidental-press margin, independent/adjacent actuation, contradictory-pair rejection and sealing-boundary fit, without artificial ageing.

gates.evidence_boundary: SA818S Rev 1.8 plus the official manufacturer package archive define one common 35.60 x 19.00-mm, 18-land host pattern for SA818S-U and SA818S-V; each contact-12 RF corridor is independent.
gates.unknown: Received SA818S-U/V lot identity, common-land tolerance, solder fillet and thermal assembly behaviour.
gates.closure: H5 locks the exact common land pattern, dual-designator population and assembly instruction before order; H7/H8 perform incoming identity, solder inspection, power/thermal smoke and conducted-RF checks on the one assembled prototype after arrival, without a separate populated coupon.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact shaft, knob and plan envelopes are manufacturer-dimensioned and fit the H1 rear-face reserve.
gates.unknown: Insertion depth, retention, push travel, feel and final rear depth on received parts.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact shaft/knob geometry and clearance before order; H7/H8 inspect fit, travel, ordinary actuation and retention on the one assembled prototype after arrival without an endurance coupon.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact B3S-1100P body, 3.3-mm plunger and height/tolerance are manufacturer-dimensioned; no speculative cap is used.
gates.unknown: PCB/enclosure press feel and accidental-press margin.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact switch/opening geometry and DRC before order; H7/H8 inspect travel, accessibility and ordinary actuation on the one assembled prototype after arrival without artificial ageing.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact C&K body and side-actuator envelope are manufacturer-dimensioned and the opening direction is explicit.
gates.unknown: Received side access, detent force and accidental motion.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact switch/aperture geometry and DRC before order; H7/H8 inspect access, ordinary actuation and accidental motion on the one assembled prototype after arrival without artificial ageing.

gates.evidence_boundary: The exact Seeed 1125R-SMT-4P body, land pattern and outward cable direction are controlled.
gates.unknown: Received Grove cable insertion, retention and strain relief.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact connector/cable geometry and deterministic routing before order; H7/H8 perform ordinary mating, continuity and strain-relief inspection on the one assembled prototype after arrival, with no prescribed mating-cycle test.

gates.evidence_boundary: The corrected mockup uses the exact 69.7x18.7-mm protected-cell envelopes inside the manufacturer-dimensioned rotated Keystone 1048P holder.
gates.unknown: Received insertion force, contact compression, polarity protection and enclosure support; values absent from manufacturer sources remain design-analysis inputs.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact holder/cradle/stop/pad geometry, polarity and load path before order; H7/H8 use one matched same-lot pair after arrival for ordinary installation/removal, continuity and visual solder/pad inspection on the one prototype. No drop, vibration, thermal-cycle or prescribed-cycle programme is required, and mixed MPN, lot, age or state of charge remains forbidden.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact 30-mm cable assemblies, module RF axes, U.FL board mates and conservative routed corridors are in the H1 collision model.
gates.unknown: Actual bend radius, strain relief, insertion force, retention and RF loss after assembly.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact cable/connector geometry and routing corridors before order; H7/H8 perform ordinary mating, bend/strain-relief inspection, continuity and conducted-RF checks on the one prototype after arrival, with no mating-cycle coupon.

gates.evidence_boundary: H1 fixes the controlled screen body, direct 50-contact ZIF, i8080-8 map, folded-tail corridor and enclosure load path; electrical and optical behavior remain qualification evidence.
gates.unknown: i8080/touch operation, optical quality, backlight current/thermal and received flex conformity.
gates.closure: H5 locks documented panel/direct-ZIF geometry, routing and deterministic assembly instructions before order; H7/H8 perform electrical, optical and thermal checks plus flex-route clearance and continuity inspection after arrival, without repeatedly cycling the flex.

gates.evidence_boundary: Exact speaker/microphone bodies fit the sourced envelopes; the microphone retains a downward interface direction without inventing aperture geometry on the PCB-face view.
gates.unknown: Enclosure acoustic treatment, cavity resonance, sealing, feedback and microphone response.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact bodies, cavity/opening geometry and assembly instructions before order; H7/H8 perform level, response, feedback, sealing and ordinary playback buzz/rattle checks on the one prototype after arrival, with no shaker or vibration programme.

gates.evidence_boundary: The active and orderable Same Sky SJ-43504-SMT-TR manufacturer drawing fixes the shielded 14.6x7.5x5.0-mm mid-mount body, four CTIA-wired conductors, two internal switches and required PCB cutout. H1 places its opening on the right UI-board edge without increasing the interboard height or colliding with another body.
gates.unknown: Received cutout tolerance, shield and solder-tab fit, enclosure opening, plug insertion/withdrawal force, CTIA and three-pole TRS behavior, retention and unplug transient remain assembled-product properties.
gates.closure: H5 locks exact connector, board cutout, enclosure opening and wiring before order; H7/H8 perform dimensional, CTIA/TRS electrical, ordinary mating, retention, detect and microphone-selection checks on the one prototype after arrival without prescribed cycles.
